About the artist

PA NGU moves through house and wider electronic music with a sound rooted in rhythm, emotion and detail. His work brings organic instrumentation, atmospheric production and melody into the same space, allowing the idea to guide the direction rather than a single genre.

Based in Cape Town, he works across performance, production and creative practice. His catalogue includes releases through GUNGANO Records, Cafe De Anatolia REC., Rise Music, Deep In Your Soul, WeAreiDyll Records and Nativemusik.

His live experience spans South Africa, Zimbabwe, Kenya, Nigeria and Angola, with appearances in clubs, festivals and collaborative settings. For promoters, the conversation begins with the room, the audience and the musical direction of the event.
